settings.heading: Started in a small workshop.
settings.body: We began building mirrors and frames because we couldn't find pieces made to last. Every order is still cut, joined, and finished by hand, one batch at a time.

settings.heading: Solid materials, considered proportions.
settings.body: Solid wood, true glass, and brass hardware — no veneer, no shortcuts. We design each piece to hold up in daily use and still feel right in a decade.

settings.heading: Crafted to reflect
settings.subheading: We make mirrors and frames the slow way — solid materials, traditional joinery, finished by hand.
